references.text: Previous verse describing the removal of the infected stones, which is part of the same cleansing process for the house
Describes what happens if leprosy returns after scraping - the house must be demolished and the material taken to an unclean place outside the city
The person with leprosy must live outside the camp, parallel to how unclean material must be taken outside the city to an unclean place
Command to send unclean people outside the camp, the same principle of removing impurity from the community
Ashes from the red heifer are to be placed in a clean place outside the camp, contrasting with the unclean place outside the city
Command to keep the camp clean by removing waste outside, the same principle of removing impurity from the dwelling
